content.user_title: Evaluate Educational Content with a Rubric
content.value_statement: Educational drafts need consistent review before publication. This skill applies a weighted rubric and constitution checklist to produce evidence-based feedback.
actual_capabilities: Scores chapters and lessons across weighted quality categories.
Applies a pass or fail constitution compliance gate.
Classifies results as Excellent, Good, Needs Work, or Insufficient.
Uses included rubric, checklist, and report template for consistency.
Provides evidence-based findings, strengths, weaknesses, and next steps.
Supports mid-draft checks, completion reviews, validation gates, and spot checks.
limitations: It depends on the content and context files supplied by the user.
It does not verify external facts unless supporting sources are provided.
It does not run code or compute metrics unless the assistant uses available tools.
Its constitution checklist reflects a specific educational standard.

use_cases.title: Review a Lesson Draft
use_cases.description: Assess a lesson before publication and identify the most important revisions.

use_cases.title: Standardize Editorial Feedback
use_cases.description: Use the same rubric across chapters so feedback remains consistent and traceable.

use_cases.title: Gate Validation Readiness
use_cases.description: Check whether content meets minimum quality and constitution requirements before validation.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Lesson Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this lesson draft using the content evaluation framework. Focus on the strongest issues and the most important fixes. Content path: [path].

prompt_templates.title: Full Completion Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this completed chapter with the full rubric and constitution checklist. Provide category scores, evidence, strengths, weaknesses, and prioritized next steps. Content path: [path].

prompt_templates.title: Pre-Validation Gate
prompt_templates.prompt: Determine whether this content is ready for validation. Apply the pass or fail constitution gate first, then calculate the weighted quality score. Content path: [path].

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Rubric Calibration
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this content with the framework, using the provided spec, plan, learning objectives, and target audience. Call out any rubric assumptions that may need adjustment. Content path: [path]. Context paths: [paths].

output_examples.input: A writer asks for a review of a completed lesson about Python functions.
output_examples.output: Overall result: Good. The lesson is technically sound and well structured, but the AI-first teaching section needs stronger guided practice. Recommended next steps include adding one co-learning exercise and simplifying two long explanations.

output_examples.input: A program lead asks whether a chapter can enter validation.
output_examples.output: Verdict: Not ready for validation. Constitution compliance is incomplete because several required evidence items are missing. Resolve the gate items before using the weighted score as a publication signal.

output_examples.input: An editor asks for a quick spot check on one section.
output_examples.output: Focused review: The section has clear examples and a logical flow. The main risk is dense language, so revise long paragraphs before a full completion review.

best_practices: Provide the draft, learning objectives, and relevant project context together.
Ask for line-referenced evidence so feedback is traceable.
Use the same rubric across drafts to compare improvement.
anti_patterns: Using the framework as a substitute for subject matter expert review.
Treating incomplete drafts as final publication decisions.
Ignoring a failed constitution gate because the weighted score is high.

faq.question: What content can this skill review?
faq.answer: It is designed for educational chapters, lessons, sections, and related learning materials.

faq.question: Does it produce a numeric score?
faq.answer: Yes. It calculates a weighted score after the constitution compliance gate passes.

faq.question: Can it review partial drafts?
faq.answer: Yes. Use a spot check or mid-draft review when the content is not complete.

faq.question: Does it replace a human editor?
faq.answer: No. It standardizes review structure, but expert review is still useful for accuracy and tone.

faq.question: What inputs improve the review quality?
faq.answer: Provide the draft, objectives, target audience, relevant specs, and any required constitution file.

faq.question: Can it be used with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
